scope: Independent integration/source review and focused synthetic tests only; no study bank generation, actual policy outcomes, study training, cloud operation or protocol freeze performed by reviewer.

settings.feedback: Native fresh RGB and current spatial code at every active input

validation.scope: Synthetic exact optimizer/policy/private/global RNG resume, both native-shaped random CNN/LSTM256 population configurations, pending endpoint states, final/intermediate resume lineage, lossless raw inputs and failure denominators.
Synthetic saved-input/physics/readout checks and adversarial raw/checkpoint/metric/provenance corruptions; independent control-action and rendering-boundary tests.

integration_findings.issue: Intermediate resumes could pin mutable latest.pt as immutable lineage evidence and fail the later audit after normal overwrite.
integration_findings.fix: Copy supplied checkpoint to latest.pt only at update1024, where no optimizer updates remain. All resumes preserve immutable resume_parent_evidence/checkpoint.pt. Both final-boundary and intermediate-overwrite regressions pass.

integration_findings.issue: Earlier resumed-failure evidence omitted failed_plan.pt and failed_predraw_streams.pt.
integration_findings.fix: Both optional files retained exactly with lineage hashes.

integration_findings.issue: Strict source packages need every input file read by protocol().
integration_findings.fix: Acquisition specification is now an explicit input_assets member as well as specification_sha256; no scientific setting changed.

auditor_scope.independent_checks: Compressed bytes and every uncompressed tensor hash; actual saved observation physics; fresh native spatial/goal codes; native raycast away from prespecified numerical boundaries; first-FREE actor/value readout; sampled-action CDF; rewards, masks, denominators, optimizer state/counters, evaluation preservation and accepted resume history.
auditor_scope.not_claimed: Full CNN/LSTM histories are not independently rerun. Training replay residuals are checked from saved logs plus hash-locked producer/tests. Initial h/c zero follows the collector/tests rather than an archived pre-input state.
auditor_scope.renderer: Boundary pixels are losslessly archived/hash checked but excluded from cross-device numerical comparison. Every active frame must retain at least50percent unambiguous checked pixels. Fixed RGB tolerance1e-4, code tolerance5e-5, geometric boundary margin5e-5.

material_limits: One original training seed pair; four acquisition arms do not establish trained-seed generalization.
The75percent endpoint is fast two-second local steering, not generic navigation, useful memory or ring evidence. Actor initialization also changes exploration.
Exact learning-resume tests use CPU synthetic/random-weight models; no live CUDA interruption/resume or actual study trajectory has been executed in this review.
supersedes: The earlier boundary addendum approved a copy for any nonzero resume before strict auditor integration. This final review narrows that approval to update1024 and preserves the historical record.
disposition: No remaining material implementation blocker. Freeze the reviewed source/settings and proceed only through the owner-authorized bounded acquisition workflow; no unrelated checks or changed ring criteria are requested.
